channel.title: Hypewire
channel.description: What people are talking about in AI, entertainment, gaming and tech, refreshed daily.

item.title: Modern Warfare 4 launches Friday, with its campaign earning strong reviews
item.description: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 releases October 23 on PS5, Xbox, PC and, for the first time, Switch 2.

item.title: PHP2Shell flaws take sites offline as attackers start probing
item.description: Two critical PHP flaws found with AI help are being widely probed, and some public bodies pulled sites offline.

item.title: DeepSeek is reported to be raising about $15 billion
item.description: China's DeepSeek is reported to be closing a round of about 100 billion yuan, double its original target.

item.title: Clayface opens Friday with fresh reviews and a $25-30 million forecast
item.description: DC's R-rated horror film about the Batman villain has a 75% Rotten Tomatoes score ahead of its October 23 opening.

item.title: EA is closing BioWare and cancelling the next Mass Effect
item.description: The studio behind Mass Effect and Dragon Age is shutting as EA cuts about 400 jobs after its $55 billion buyout.

item.title: Apple's $1,999 iPhone Duo goes on sale with thin walk-in stock
item.description: Apple's first foldable iPhone launches October 23, with limited walk-in stock and some orders slipping to January.

item.title: Claude Duet opens its waitlist, running on an unreleased Opus 5.5
item.description: Anthropic opened a US waitlist for Claude Duet, a proactive assistant it says runs on its unreleased Opus 5.5 model.

item.title: Final screen tests for the next James Bond are reported to be underway
item.description: Amazon MGM and director Denis Villeneuve are said to be testing a shortlist of actors in London.

item.title: Capcom confirms a breach of its Capcom ID accounts
item.description: Account details of more than 11 million Capcom ID users are reported to be exposed, but not card data.

item.title: Google DeepMind researchers quit over the company's military AI work
item.description: Two researchers told the BBC they left over how Google's AI may be used by the Pentagon.

item.title: Xbox is reported to be planning an a la carte Game Pass
item.description: Fortune reports players could pick features like cloud play and multiplayer separately in a tiered Game Pass.

item.title: Nathan Fielder's Holmes film goes wide after winning Wednesday's box office
item.description: After a $15.6 million start from 855 screens, A24's You Can See Everything expands to 2,500+ screens on Friday.

item.title: A trailer for the cancelled next Mass Effect leaks online
item.description: Footage said to be from the fifth Mass Effect game appeared on Reddit days after EA said it was closing BioWare.

item.title: Chip and hardware stocks slide in a broad tech sell-off
item.description: Coherent fell nearly 12% and IBM, Micron and Intel dropped sharply as tech stocks sold off on October 22.

item.title: Micron workers in Taiwan stage the island's first chip strike
item.description: Union members at Micron's Taoyuan plant walked out for 24 hours over how AI memory profits are shared.

item.title: A Glee reboot gets the green light at Disney+ and Hulu
item.description: Disney+ and Hulu greenlit a new Glee, and Lea Michele is reported to be returning as Rachel Berry.

item.title: Meta's revenue jumps 26% while legal costs and AI spending squeeze profit
item.description: Meta made $64.6 billion in Q3 but took a $9.9 billion legal charge and raised its yearly spending outlook.

item.title: Walmart opens its store to approved AI shopping agents
item.description: Walmart's Agent Gateway lets approved AI agents search stock and buy, with spending caps per agent.

item.title: OpenAI's models are coming to Google Cloud
item.description: Google Cloud customers will get OpenAI's frontier models and Codex through Model Garden and its marketplace.

item.title: Private equity firms are said to have valued Xbox at $100-150 billion
item.description: The Information reports brief, exploratory buyout talks about Xbox that never reached Microsoft as a formal offer.

item.title: Final Fantasy Resonance is out now after strong early reviews
item.description: Square Enix's HD-2D game launched October 22 on consoles including Xbox, PS5 and Switch 2.

item.title: Barclays plans about 5,000 job cuts as AI raises productivity
item.description: The bank is cutting about 5% of its workforce, with roughly 60% of roles in support functions.

item.title: Tesla's profit falls 44% even as it beats forecasts
item.description: Tesla's Q3 net income fell to $787 million, but adjusted EPS of $0.48 beat estimates.

item.title: Recursive releases Flint, a small open coding model built by an automated lab
item.description: Flint has about 40 billion parameters, uses 2.5 billion per token and is free under Apache 2.0.

item.title: Dario Amodei defends Anthropic's safety record against a long critique
item.description: Anthropic's CEO answered Encode AI's Nathan Calvin in a 2,000-word post and admitted some missteps.

item.title: Jailer 2 passes Rs 317 crore net in India in its first week
item.description: Rajinikanth's sequel made Rs 28.15 crore on Wednesday, taking its India net total to Rs 317.20 crore, Sacnilk reports.

item.title: AI lab Flapping Airplanes raises $1 billion at a $6 billion value
item.description: The year-old research startup's Series A was led by Index Ventures and Lux Capital.

item.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie hits Netflix in the US on November 30
item.description: The year's first $1 billion film streams on Netflix earlier than forecasters expected, after its Peacock run.

item.title: Anthropic pitches a law that could halt a model judged too dangerous
item.description: Anthropic's draft bill would let the Commerce Department ask a court to suspend a model over catastrophic risk.

item.title: PS5 sales rise while Xbox hits a September low in the US
item.description: Circana's September figures show PS5 up 22%, Switch 2 down 14% and Xbox Series down 27% from a year ago.

item.title: Judge orders Meta to pay $25 billion in New Mexico's privacy case
item.description: The penalty covers nearly 44 million violations tied to Cambridge Analytica, and Meta plans to appeal.

item.title: Nvidia shows a data center that ships in containers at GTC Berlin
item.description: Nvidia's DSX POD packs its Vera Rubin design into containers it says cut deployment to about 14 days.

item.title: Cyberpunk 2077 update 2.5 is out, with Edgerunners 2 content and mods
item.description: CD Projekt's Edgerunners 2 update arrived October 22 and adds cross-platform mod support on consoles.

item.title: eMudhra quits the web certificate business after its keys proved guessable
item.description: The Indian certificate authority is leaving the global SSL/TLS market after keys for eight certificates were recovered.

item.title: Laika's stop-motion epic Wildwood opens with perfect early reviews
item.description: Travis Knight's adaptation of the Colin Meloy novel opens October 23 with a 100% Rotten Tomatoes critics' score.

item.title: First previews of Sega's Stranger Than Heaven are mostly positive
item.description: RGG Studio's 50-year crime drama impressed most critics after a three-hour session ahead of its January 15 release.

item.title: Palantir says it cannot remotely switch off NATO's AI system
item.description: Palantir told Reuters neither it nor the US government can disable the Maven Smart System NATO uses.

item.title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 arrives on Netflix, with Hideo Kojima in the cast
item.description: The 10-episode standalone sequel to the 2022 anime launched on October 20, and a matching game update is out.

item.title: LiteLLM blames a leaked GitHub token for its poisoned release
item.description: LiteLLM says its release pipeline was hijacked on October 21 to push a malicious 1.107.0 build to PyPI and Docker.

item.title: Street Fighter faces a steep second weekend after its $31 million debut
item.description: Boxoffice Pro forecasts $8 million to $13 million for Street Fighter's second weekend.

item.title: Oppo launches the Find X10 phones with up to three 200MP cameras
item.description: The Find X10 Pro Max has three 200MP sensors and a 7,150 mAh battery, starting at about EUR 1,799 in Spain.
